title: Chat/set group member patch keys unimplemented
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Updating a Chat: addMembers/removeMembers/updateMemberRoles 'all require admin role, except leaving the group'; overQuota on addMembers; role 'MUST be "admin" or "member"; the server MUST reject any other value with an invalidProperties SetError'. chat.rs:478-617 has no handling; memory.rs:893-970 stores the keys verbatim into Chat.extra, so the patch 'succeeds' with members unchanged and junk keys returned by Chat/get. Prerequisite for JMAP-yt1w.4(b) (leave/close). Also implementer-guide SHOULD: refuse last-admin self-demote via updateMemberRoles. Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
notes: fix done in fdc56b3b: tests added crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_group_member_keys.rs (11 tests: admin-only, self-leave, overQuota, invalid role, last-admin self-demote, no extra storage) and testjig chat_client_wire::chat_update_member_patch_keys
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
